tex_content.html:
\begin{equation} (r_F(t),\kappa _F(t),\delta _F(t),h_F(t)) =\bigl(r(j),\kappa (j),\delta (t),h(\delta (t)r(j),\delta (t))\bigr). \end{equation}

The half-open convention is essential at an epoch boundary: the old value is used strictly before the boundary, while the next value is used at and after it.
